newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF says no worry exists on bad loan problem.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF says no worry exists on bad loan problem.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a parliamentary committee on Thursday that he did not think any financial worries existed at present over the massive problem loans of Japanese financial institutions.
"I believe there are no financial worries stemming from the problem loans at the moment," Mitsuzuka told a key budget committee of parliament's Lower House.
He acknowledged that financial worries had been one of the main factors contributing to the recent fall in Tokyo share prices.

But the government was backing financial institutions' efforts to get rid of the bad loans and to restructure their businesses, and the firms were well on their way towards solving the bad loan problem by 2001, Mitsuzuka said.
